may 1 Notes:


I took a winning trade for the day and it was off of a 5min rejection block. I was thinking I would get a 10:00 setup today, but it never played out.
,
At market open, price rallied all the way until 10:00 which we saw consolidation and then a retracement afterwards. We did not see a move all the way down into discount, but into a 15m and 30m discounted fvg. From there we had a 5min fvg (bearish candle followed by bullish) and it was a really big wick so I was looking to enter off of the ce, and we had consolidated above it generating some el on the 1min time frame. and by the time nq reached ce, es took the low and made an smt further confirming our trade. I targeted all time highs because there were equal highs there and the trade hit full profit for a 1:7 (Screenshots 1 & 2)
,
The rest of the day was mostly consolidation, but this was a good trade that eliminated all of my losses in april and put me at a new high in my eval.
,

messages.content_text:
this is my true 30 day challenge 

Only days i take a trade count towards this post.

My rules:

to trade only RB entries or 10am/2pm
,
Valid RBs are ones made from gaps, OTE or sweeps/smt
,
Only to use 1m RBs as ET from 10am or larger RB or OTE on smaller ranges (10am range)
,
Can take the start or the CE of the RB seeing where OTE lines up with best
,
To have a clear bais and DOL of where i want price to go
,
Can use SMT as an entry trig aswell with SL in a safe spot
,
Can enter straight of OTE as long as the SL is in a safe spot (mostly as an ET if not RB is there)
,

Trades: 

1 W then off
,
2 Ls then hop off
,
3 trades max
,
if i miss a setup or just dont get an entry on a move i wanted to then become more picky to help stop just hoping in a trade
,

Gotta journal everytrade and make sure they fit with all these rules else i will have to start again (edited)
